in_sanskrit.name: Hebah
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Love
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hebah एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘He’ meaning sun and ‘Bah’ meaning love, Hebah is the name of the Goddess of Love in Hindu mythology. She is depicted as a beautiful woman holding a lotus flower in one hand and a bow in the other. Hebah is also known as the Goddess of Marriage and Fertility, and is revered for her ability to bring harmony and joy to relationships.
